candidates.statement: Order service's postgres save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool is fully saturated (size 5, idle 0) across all sampled checkout traces, causing order /v1/orders 503s and gateway /v1/checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Pool size/idle come from trace attributes only; no pool metrics or postgres-side saturation telemetry to confirm exhaustion versus postgres unavailability.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s trace to order /v1/orders 503s, whose postgres.save_order spans error with DependencyUnavailable and show pool size 5 / idle 0. Order metrics show 13.5/min 503s on /v1/orders and postgres save_order operations, while inventory/payment calls succeed. Consistent with db-pool-exhaustion; postgres-side evidence still needed.
